_about: Fingerprints of the XSL-FO of three builds (see canon() in jss-cover-isolation.test.js: the checkout location and the attribute order are ignored, so the value is the same in every folder on every machine). Re-captured 2026-11-23 at the merge of the JSS authoring work (Videos copy) with the S1000D Phase 20-22d work. Both pre-merge trees, measured separately before any file was combined, gave exactly these values - so neither the JSS edits nor the S1000D edits moved any of these three builds - and the merged tree must give them again. The earlier values were captured with the checkout location inside them and could not be reproduced in any other folder. Update only when a change to these pipelines is intended and reviewed. capturedOn is the calendar day of the capture: the FO of an S1000D build prints the day it was built ("Issue No. 001, 2026-11-23"), so the test replaces the day of the run with capturedOn before it fingerprints (see norm()), and the values stay valid on every other day. RE-CAPTURED 2026-11-24 (legacy-jss-uhb and s1000d-via-jss only; s1000d-direct is unchanged and still equals the 2026-11-23 value) at the merge of the Naval work with the owner's commit eb43711 (ancillary pages). That commit changes four files every jsstofo build uses, on purpose and in every profile: vendor/pipeline/jsstofo/pagesetup.xsl (the pad pages that close a chapter or a front-matter part carry the running head and foot), tables.xsl and warnings.xsl (a table and a notice span the full text width at every heading level), and templates/uhb.house.json (chapter titles 21 pt instead of 18 pt). Shown to be the whole cause: with exactly those four files put back to their previous content, all three builds gave the 2026-11-23 values again, byte for byte. The S1000D direct engine does not include them and did not move. The "chars" of the two re-captured cases were not re-measured and are left out. RE-CAPTURED 2026-11-25 (legacy-jss-uhb and s1000d-via-jss only; s1000d-direct is unchanged and still equals the 2026-11-23 value) at the merge of the Naval work with the owner's commits c4bc7bf and d727032. c4bc7bf adds default artwork for every JSS book (applyDefaultArtwork in publisher.ts, vendor/pipeline/jss/artwork: the stencil's emblem, Larsen & Toubro logo and first-aid figures, used when the project has no such file in its Media folder), on purpose and for the two JSS paths only; its own test asserts that the direct S1000D engine never gets it. Shown to be the whole cause: with applyDefaultArtwork switched off all three builds gave the previous values again, byte for byte; with it on, the only differences in the XSL-FO are the src of the emblem, publisher-logo and first-aid pictures (12 lines in the old JSS path, 8 in S1000D through JSS) and the first-aid box height (115 mm to 145 mm, fm.firstAidImageHeight) in the old JSS path. RE-CAPTURED 2026-11-27 (legacy-jss-uhb) for audit WP-07: PUB-012 removes the shipped defaults that named artwork which does not exist (a developer screenshot, Media/Screenshot 2026-09-05 160259.png, on the system-name page, and six hazard-symbol icons, Media/High_Voltage_Symbol.png and five more); a symbol without a picture no longer gets src="" (vendor/engine/frontmatter.js). Shown to be the whole cause: with templates/uhb.house.json, vendor/engine/frontmatter.js and vendor/pipeline/jss/frontmatter/13-description-of-symbols.xml put back to their previous content the build gives the previous value 71b76ad9... again; with them, the only differences in the XSL-FO are the screenshot graphic replaced by the page's ruled 200 mm frame and the six symbol graphics replaced by the empty 10 mm frames (30 lines). The same measurement shows that PUB-020 (default artwork passed as file: URLs instead of ../ steps) does not move the fingerprint, because canon() maps both forms to the same token. The same change, measured the same way (templates/default.house.json added to the files put back), also moves s1000d-direct (re-captured 2026-11-27; its chars are not re-measured and are left out) and s1000d-via-jss (re-captured 2026-11-27): put back, both give their previous values (794e3aaa..., ad92c3e0...) again; with the change, the direct engine differs only in the screenshot graphic of the system-name page being left out (3 lines), and S1000D through JSS only in the same seven pictures as the old JSS path (30 lines).
